zh-CN.title: 聊天气泡预览更轻量
items: 气泡预览模式取消展示聊天 Header 与底部输入框
整个预览区域最高不超过屏幕高度的 40%
不同类型消息继续在预览框内部滚动查看

en.title: A lighter chat-bubble preview
items: Bubble preview mode no longer shows the chat header or bottom composer
The complete preview is capped at 40% of the viewport height
All message types remain available through scrolling inside the preview
